services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Join Toronto’s tropical tiki boat experience as an Influencer and collaborate with us to share the vibes. We offer exclusive, tiered perks based on your audience size. Bring your crew, enjoy a cruise, and share the experience with your followers. Heads up! This limited influencer program is running exclusively in May 2025 to help us kick off the season. A chance to ride early, create first, and be part of the launch crew before summer hits full swing. All perks include influencer + guests. All collaborations must be approved. Palapa Tours reserves final

gap: Age minimum for private charters not explicitly stated
blurb: Guests enjoy a 90-minute tiki boat cruise on Toronto Harbour with a licensed captain and bartender. The boat features a handcrafted wooden bar, thatched roof, onboard restroom, WiFi, and a fully licensed bar. Private charters and individual tickets are available, with music and drinks onboard.
extraNote: All bookings are final sale · Refunds only available if Trip Protection purchased at booking · Trip Protection allows cancellation or rescheduling up to 48 hours before tour · Tours sail rain or shine unless unsafe weather; may be postponed or rescheduled · 18% auto gratuity applied to all onboard bar tabs · Late arrival or disruptive behavior results in cancellation with no refund · 319 Queens Quay W at the East Corner of HTO Park · May 1 - October 31
